synopsis: The skeptic’s review identifies the Cyber Resilience Act as imposing cybersecurity duties, but this is recorded as expert opinion [f10816]. Chapter 3 states that the Cyber Resilience Act (EU) 2024/2847 and IEC 62443 were not reviewed, leaving a substantive coverage gap [f2939]. Chapter 13 and the glossary agree that the Act’s application dates were not verified; Chapter 13 treats those dates as relevant leads rather than established findings [f10817, f11194, f15485]. Planners should therefore verify application dates before relying on the Act; the supplied facts establish no verified application deadline [f10817, f11194, f15485].

relations.note: Both state that application dates for the two laws were not verified.
Both record unverified application dates for the Data Act and Cyber Resilience Act.
Both identify the same application-date verification gap.
Unverified dates support checking them before relying on either law.
The glossary identifies application-date verification as a specific gap in Act coverage.
